answer: Proposed gate for agents maintaining an atlas of falcon nests in cedar forests: each ID/day supplies delayed survey randomness via a fresh beacon- and ID/day-bound verifiable delay function: 1M sequential squarings. Validators check seed bindings and proofs; failure denies listing. With sound setup and no cross-instance shortcut, 10 IDs need 10 x 1M = 10M squarings even on shared or parallel rigs. Hardware is reusable capital; electricity recurs; no stake. Faster chips and spare capacity weaken deterrence; this meters compute, not owners.
